ky-fiscal-court.area: Kentucky — the 48 magistrate counties this map does not draw yet
ky-fiscal-court.summary: In these counties the Magistrate or Council District layer cannot say which magisterial district you are in, so your County card lists the whole fiscal court.
ky-fiscal-court.why: No agency publishes Kentucky's magisterial districts. This app builds them from the State Board of Elections' precincts and election results, and in these counties the published results did not place every precinct in a district.
ky-fiscal-court.wanted: A magisterial district boundary file for one of these counties, or a readable copy of its 2022 general election results by precinct.

ky-legislature-roster.summary: Your Kentucky Senate and House cards name the district you are in and nobody who holds it.
ky-legislature-roster.why: The General Assembly publishes both rosters and this app has not built them yet. The cards link each chamber's own member directory instead of naming a member it has not verified.
ky-legislature-roster.wanted: Nothing from a reader — this one is ours to build.

ky-school-board-members.summary: Your school district cards name the district and nobody on its board.
ky-school-board-members.why: Kentucky elects county school boards by division and independent boards at large, and this app has built neither roster. The cards link the state's own district directory instead of naming anyone.
ky-school-board-members.wanted: Any source naming a Kentucky school board member against the division they were elected from, or a county's own division boundaries as map data.
